verdict.rationale: The skills ship as SKILL.md files in per-skill folders, the layout the Agent Skills format uses. The vendor claims they work with any agent, naming Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, and the installer writes editable files for whichever agents you pick. Cross-vendor portability is therefore claimed, but the evidence never states conformance to the open Agent Skills specification. Missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec compliance, documented spec-required frontmatter/fields, independent or hands-on verification that the same folder loads unchanged in non-Claude tools.
